shared_elements: procession of human figures in profile facing the same direction
long garments with patterned lower hems
low-relief single register frieze with figures on a common groundline
animal led within the procession (camel in A; horse/animal-related elements in B)
justification: Both show a single-register low-relief frieze of bearded, capped male figures striding in profile in the same direction, overlapping in file and carrying objects, essentially a tribute/procession scheme with an animal included. The clearest differences in content are A's dominant large camel led by a groom and its rosette borders framing the register, versus B's denser mass of near-identical marching figures with tall pointed caps, a raised throne/canopy-like structure and no floral border.
